Notis-Mcconarty Edward decreased its stake in Wells Fargo (WFC) by 66.01% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 5,200 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $315,000, down from 15,300 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Notis-Mcconarty Edward who had been investing in Wells Fargo for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $266.60B market cap company. The stock increased 1.77% or $0.95 during the last trading session, reaching $54.71. About 11.40 million shares traded. Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE:WFC) has declined 7.75% since May 10, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.30% the S&P500.
